question: The simplified value of 48 - (- 18) × (- 60 - 72 - 92) ÷ [8×{2 + (- 6)(- 9)}] is:
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: 48 - (-18) × (-60 - 72 - 92) ÷ [8 × {2 + (-6)(-9)}]

**Formula Used:**

Order of operations: BODMAS (Brackets, Orders, Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 48 - (-18) × (-60 - 72 - 92) ÷ [8 × {2 + (-6)(-9)}]

⇒ 48 - (-18) × (-60 - 72 - 92) ÷ [8 × {2 + 54}]

⇒ 48 - (-18) × (-224) ÷ [8 × 56]

⇒ 48 - (-18) × (-224) ÷ 448

⇒ 48 - (-18) × -0.5

⇒ 48 - 9

⇒ 39

**The simplified value is 39.**
